# Supply terms

Acme LLC (hereinafter the Supplier) shall deliver the goods named in Schedule 1
to the Buyer. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Supplier may withhold delivery
subject to Clause 4.

The parties shall sign the DPA before any personal data moves. The DPA applies
under the GDPR, and the Supplier shall comply with it. Notwithstanding Clause 4,
the Buyer may end the agreement by written notice, subject to Clause 9.

Either party shall keep the terms of this agreement confidential, subject to
Clause 12 and to any order of a court.
